_doc: Named retail state for rd expressions (tools/drive/README.md). Each entry: {addr, type} or {expr}; status = shown in every status line; event = changes reported by `rd play`. Only entries VALIDATED on a live run belong here (say how in `note`); a run's own experiments go to <run>/vars.json (rd ram R define without --shared).

scene.note: DAT_0438b1c0: 0 title, 1 in game (house / shop / dungeon), 2 game over, 6 market / guild, 9 pause menu, 11 adventurers' guild

loading.note: a load is pending (the LOADING_* anchors)

dlg.note: 1 while a dialogue / event script owns the game

cc08.note: DAT_0438cc08 in-scene mode: 0 free roam, 4 customer service, 10 counter menu, 15..18/30 Tear's menu pages, 0x17/3 decor editor (docs/findings/shop-counter-menu-RE.md)

bank.note: VA of the active working bank (layout: tools/save_arena_map.json, dword D at bank + 4*D)

pause.note: non-zero while a pause overlay is up (the pause MENU is scene 9)

reveal.note: dialogue text reveal state (1 while a line types out)

revdone.note: non-zero once the current line is fully shown

line.note: >= 0 while a dialogue line is on screen

t_fade.note: title: submenu fade (0 = main menu takes input, 10 = a submenu is fully in)

t_sub.note: title: open submenu (1 save picker, 2 settings, 3 encyclopedia, 4 records)

t_cur.note: title: main-menu cursor (index into the item list)

t_item.note: title: item code under the cursor (1 Continue, 0/5 New Game, 4 New Game+, 6 survival)

t_start.note: title: game-start counter (0 at the title, 1 once a start is chosen)

pm_type.note: pause menu: type of the selected entry (1 Items, 2 Options, 3 Save, 6 Encyclopedia)

pm_state.note: pause menu: 10 = an entry's page is open

mlevel.note: merchant level, 0-based (HUD shows +1); bank dword 0xb100. Probes: 5 in dungeon3-run2-save, list gates match (tear-orders-l10, move-tables-l10)

tx.note: Tear x (tear-news-orders: 0.6 at the morning spot)

reach.note: DAT_0438be7c: 20 when Tear is in reach (within 2, facing her) — A then opens her menu

cc0c.note: list cursor of the counter menu (cc08 0) and Tear's menu (cc08 15)

cc04.note: house sub-mode (1 = the display menu over a table cell)

tentry.note: Tear's menu: entry code under the cursor (0 Store Atmosphere, 5 Merchant Level, 7 Lectures, 8 News Summary, 9 Outstanding Orders, 6 Time Lecture, 4 Never Mind)

centry.note: counter menu: entry code under the cursor (0 Open Store, 1 Flooring, 2 Walls, 3 Carpet, 4 Tables, 5 Move Tables, 6 Cancel); the list is built when the menu opens

gmode.note: Merchants' Guild menu mode c00: 1 main list, 0 item / fusion list, 3 sell pick, 4 expansion confirm, 5 fusion confirm, 6 result anim, 8 quantity

gcur.note: guild main cursor c04 (day 14: Buy, Sell, Fusion, Talk, Leave)

fcur.note: fusion list cursor c30 (scroll c34 at 0x9642c34; result anim bfc 0x9642bfc; output plus bf8 0x9642bf8; recipe count 0x9642bf4)

wm_cur.note: town map cursor (3 = Merchants' Guild; scene 8)

mt_sel.note: Move Tables (cc08 2): the table in hand; count at 0x438bfb4; table i grid x / z at bank+183824+8i / bank+183828+8i

floor.note: DAT_0438b4cc dungeon floor, 0-based (0 in the shop and on 1F; the HUD plate shows +1)

o_dirty.note: pause Options page phase: 1 dirty, 2 = save on the next tick (FUN_004905a8(-1)), 3 clean exit

stage.note: DAT_0438b4dc stage record: < 4 = a shop stage (0 at home), >= 4 = a dungeon (4 = Hall of Trials)

stime.note: time of day (bank dword 0xb0fc): 0 morning .. 3 evening; 4 ends the day. A town trip / an opening costs periods; the Pub opens from 2, the Adventurers' Guild closes in the evening

hp.note: dungeon: the leader's HP (HUD-validated, probe dungeon2-21f-25f)

portal.note: dungeon: the exit prompt (1.. = "Go to the next floor?" is up)

equipq.note: guild departure: the "Equip items in bag?" prompt

lock.note: dungeon: -1 = the player has control (a boss intro holds it at 0)

ticker.note: dungeon: floor-event ticker; play is frozen while it is non-zero (A after 30 ticks speeds it up)

ex.note: dungeon: the exit portal's x (object 0, kind 8 at +0x8c)

gate.note: dungeon: the exit object's state (3 = hidden: a boss floor)

exitd.note: dungeon: distance to the exit portal (a search score: --score "-exitd")

a0hp.note: actor 0's HP. Actor table: 0x76b970 + i*0xba4; type +0x424 (s32), in use +0x428, hp +0x42c (f32), x / z +0x3f0 / +0x3f8 (f32), yaw +0x420

wms.note: town map: the 7 destination states as digits — Home, Market, Town Square, Merchants' Guild, Pub, Chapel, Adventurers' Guild; 0 disabled, 1 open, 2 an event waits (a normal morning reads 1111011)

sid.note: the event script running / last run: group*1000 + number (6002 = script 6/2); probes calendar-week3 / -week4

enc_cat.note: pause → Encyclopedia: category (count s32 0x964c42c = 33); probe pause-encyclopedia

enc_row.note: Encyclopedia: cursor row (rows in the category: enc_rows)

enc_top.note: Encyclopedia: the scroll window's top row (3 rows visible)

enc_rows.note: Encyclopedia: rows in the current category

enc_slide.note: Encyclopedia: category-change slide, ±1..±10; input is blocked while it runs

enc_detail.note: Encyclopedia: 1 while the detail box is up (stays 1 after B closes the page)

vend0.note: vending machine 0's item code (0x51440 = Old Vender; 0 = none placed); probes vending-level16 / vender-sales-l16

vstock.note: vending machine 0: stocked slots of 6 (bank dwords 0xb1e8..0xb1ed: an item code or -1; a sale empties one slot and pays the base price)

d_table.note: the shop's table kind (all tables at once): 0 Wooden, 1 Legendary, 3 Barrel = counter item id - 5301; probe change-tables-l16

p_act.note: player action: 0 free, 1 hurt, 2 sword swing (30 ticks, the hit lands at p_actt 9), 4..8 skills (bcore-2)

p_inv.note: player invulnerability ticks (<= 0 = hittable; 30 after a hit)

p_hurt.note: player knock-down hold (70 after a crown slime landing)

estage.note: dungeon floor event stage (generic boss floor: 1 = cleared; code-read)

rx.note: the sword record's x (1.0 ahead of the player): hit labels are judged from here

a0st.note: actor 0: AI state (8 = boss intro; 1..6 on most = attacking: hits then are Counter Attacks)

a0pow.note: actor 0: DF scale: effective DF = DF * pow^2 (crown slime 5 -> 1; crab 5)

a0rel.expr: abs(atan2(sin(atan2(a0x - rx, a0z - rz) - a0yaw + pi), cos(atan2(a0x - rx, a0z - rz) - a0yaw + pi)))
a0rel.note: hit-label angle on actor 0: < pi/4 front (no label), pi/4..3pi/4 Side Attack x1.2, > 3pi/4 back x1.5 (docs/findings/bosses/combat-core.md)

exitcx.note: dungeon: the exit CELL's x index (BFS target; ex / ez read object 0, which is not always the exit: lapis-71f-80f)

exitcz.note: dungeon: the exit CELL's z index

doorobj.note: dungeon: the return door's object index (0x6a47054 = the next-floor portal's); objects at 0x695ef78 + i*0x2a0

doorst.note: dungeon: the return door's state: 0 shut, 1 open (a sword hit opens it; walking into it before does nothing). Verified lapis-71f-80f f44300 → f44330
